title: PIXL Nic Salts Lemon Lime 10ml E-Liquid
description: The classic, zesty citrus duo. A perfect balance of sharp, tangy Lemon and bright, zingy Lime for an unmistakably refreshing all-day vape .Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, these 10ml e-liquids use nicotine salts to provide a smoother, more immediate form of nicotine satisfaction compared to traditional freebase nicotine. They are the perfect choice for vapers seeking a satisfying, flavour-packed experience. This premium e-liquid is part of the PIXL Nic Salt collection, a range from the brand that created the popular PIXL prefilled pod kit. This collection is dedicated to crafting bold, clear, and satisfying flavours, all formulated as 10ml nic salts. PIXL Nic Salts are crafted with a 50% VG / 50% PG ratio, making them ideal for use in low-powered MTL (Mouth-to-Lung) vape kits, such as pod systems and starter kits. This balanced blend ensures a smooth throat hit, discreet vapour production, and excellent flavour delivery.
